I will patch the briefs for FIG. 2 and FIG. 6 to correctly describe the channel as a continuous feature that appears in section as troughs.

The second finding relates to an unsupported detail in the figure brief for FIG. 4, which specifies the location of the resilient feet on the spacer frame. The inventor's disclosure does not specify this location. I will patch the brief to remove this unsupported detail, describing the part simply as a resilient foot of the frame.

These changes will align the figure briefs with the inventor's disclosure and the rest of the application, resolving all findings in the gate report. No other changes are needed.

text:
I have reviewed the gate report and applied the specified fixes to the patent application draft. The core issue was an unsupported assertion in the detailed description and two dependent claims regarding the sequence of events during the closing of the carrier's lid. The original text claimed that the thermal module registration completes *before* the lid gasket begins to seal, a detail not present in the inventor's disclosure.

I have corrected this by:
1.  Revising the relevant paragraph in `draft/08-detailed-description.md` to state that registration occurs as the lid is closed and is sealed by the same motion, removing the unsupported temporal ordering.
2.  Amending claim 2 in `draft/09-claims.md` to remove the "before" limitation, correcting the relationship between registration and gasket compression.
3.  Amending method claim 13 in `draft/09-claims.md` to similarly remove the unsupported sequence, ensuring the claim is consistent with the disclosure.

These changes resolve all findings in the gate report, bringing the application into compliance with the source material.
